objects.name: rayBuffer
objects.description: Camera whose primary rays are supplied per pixel by the application

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: ray origin used for every pixel when 'ray.org' is absent

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: ray direction used for every pixel when 'ray.dir' is absent

parameters.name: ray.org
parameters.description: per-pixel ray origins, dimensions must match the frame size

parameters.name: ray.dir
parameters.description: per-pixel ray directions (normalized by the device), dimensions must match the frame size

parameters.name: ray.tmin
parameters.description: per-pixel ray interval start (default 0), dimensions must match the frame size

parameters.name: ray.tmax
parameters.description: per-pixel ray interval end (default FLT_MAX), dimensions must match the frame size
